channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Make choices that fit your real priorities this season
item.description: Balancing commitments during the busy holiday season means making choices that align with your true priorities, even if it means saying no and risking disappointing others.

item.title: Football Forecast Week 16
item.description: Wilson Prep advances to the NCHSAA 1-A football championship as the Forecast panel’s leaderboard tightens, with just three games separating the top pickers and regional finals set for this week.

item.title: Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week: Travon Usher, Wilson Preparatory Academy
item.description: Travon Usher, senior quarterback and running back at Wilson Preparatory Academy, earns Student-Athlete of the Week honors after leading his team to its first state football championship game.

item.title: Wilson - Invitation to Worship
item.description: Small Congregation inviting other small congregation without sanctuary for Sunday worship with us at 409 Atlantic Christian College Dr, Wilson NC . Contact Rev. Jim Bogle 919-710-3398. COME JOIN US FOR SOLID CHRISTIAN FELLOWSHIP!

item.title: For Your Health: Building trust through quality
item.description: Wilson Medical Center highlights the vital role of quality in patient care, introducing senior quality officer Dayna Vidal, whose leadership is strengthening safety, teamwork and trust throughout the hospital.

item.title: Tigers turn back 8-A Green Level for 1st win
item.description: Wilson Prep secured its first win of the season, edging 8-A Green Level 71-68, with Lamar Atkinson scoring 25 points and making six 3-pointers in a historic matchup after NCHSAA realignment.

item.title: Community briefs: Christmas events planned throughout the county
item.description: Area events include Christmas parades, tree lightings, concerts and community gatherings throughout December.

item.title: Warriors, Monarchs battle for state championship berth
item.description: Top-seeded Hunt and Northside-Jacksonville, both 11-2, face off in the NCHSAA 5-A East Region football final, with a state championship berth on the line in their first-ever meeting.

item.title: It’s all aboard the Train of Lights
item.description: Wilson’s Train of Lights returns for the holiday season at Recreation Park, offering festive miniature train rides, dazzling displays, treats and a scavenger hunt.

item.title: LGC approves funding for Frederick Douglass Elementary
item.description: The Local Government Commission has approved $35.5 million in financing for Frederick Douglass Elementary School and other Wilson County projects, clearing the way for construction to begin in Elm City.
